tools.name: get_context
tools.description: ALWAYS call this FIRST, before reading or searching files yourself. Returns the minimal relevant slice of this codebase for a task: the exact code in play plus the API surface of its real dependencies — typically 10-20x fewer tokens than reading the files. Powered by OIOXO, 100% on-device.

query.description: The task or question, in natural language (include identifiers/error text when you have them).

tools.name: get_skeleton
tools.description: The API surface of one file — signatures, no implementation bodies. Use to learn how to CALL code without paying for its full text.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: Blast radius of a file: what it imports and everything that imports IT. Call before refactoring or deleting to know what may break.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save one durable fact about THIS project to .oioxo/memory.md (on-device, shared with the OIOXO IDEs). Use for decisions, conventions, gotchas worth keeping.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: This project's rules + the memories most RELEVANT to a query (semantic, on-device), from .oioxo/. Call when starting work or to pull what's known about a topic.

query.description: Optional — what you want to recall about (ranks memories by relevance). Omit for rules + recent memory.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List everything OIOXO remembers about THIS project (on-device store), with ids you can pass to forget_memory. Pinned first. Use to review or audit what's been learned.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Delete one memory from THIS project's on-device store by its id (from list_memories). Use when a remembered fact is wrong or stale.

id.description: The memory id (first 8 chars from list_memories is enough).

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return the top results (title, url, snippet). Use to discover docs or current info you do not already know, then fetch_url the most relevant result.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a web page (http/https only) and return its readable text. Use to read a doc/article — typically a URL found via web_search.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Drive a REAL browser on this machine to see and test web pages — navigate, read a numbered snapshot of clickable elements, click/type by ref, screenshot. Runs LOCALLY (the page never leaves the device). Local URLs (localhost) are always allowed; set allow_external:true to permit other sites. Call one verb at a time; after navigate the result lists elements like [3] button "Sign in" — click by that ref.

ref.description: For click/type/scrollTo: element number from the latest snapshot.

text.description: For type: text to enter. For click: visible text to match. For waitFor: text to wait for.

submit.description: For type: press Enter after typing.

allow_external.description: Permit navigating to non-local sites (privacy gate; default false).
